title.en: An Act Declaring March Twenty-seven of Every Year a Special Nonworking Public Holiday in the Municipality of San Juan to Commemorate the Anniversary and Formation of San Juan as An Independent Municipality By Virtue of Philippine Commission Act No. 1625
title.orig: An Act Declaring March Twenty-seven of Every Year a Special Nonworking Public Holiday in the Municipality of San Juan to Commemorate the Anniversary and Formation of San Juan as An Independent Municipality By Virtue of Philippine Commission Act No. 1625

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1994/ra_7669_1994.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: March Twenty-seven of every year is hereby declared a special nonworking public holiday in the Municipality of San Juan, to be known as "Araw ng San Juan," to commemorate the anniversary and formation of San Juan as an independent municipality by virtue of Philippine Commission Act No. 1625.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
